ksum_conditions: Submit KSUM UID certificate and Sample Analysis Requisition Form
ksum_mou_details: R&D laboratory rates for five years.
column_15: Central Sophisticated Instrumentation Facility (CSIF) - University of Calicut
column_16: Startups with a valid KSUM UID can avail access to instrumentation services at user fee rates applicable to ‘R&D laboratories’ for a period of five years from the date of commencement of the startup. Upon completion of this period, the applicable user fee will transition to the standard rates prescribed for industry users. Eligible applicants are required to submit the requisite documents, as instructed from CSIF, for verification of the date of commencement of operations (KSUM Unique ID certificate) along with the duly completed sample analysis requisition form. To know more
